title: Nourishing Earthy Irish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and earthy Irish lamb stew featuring pomegranate molasses, this dish is perfect for a cold winter's night. The ice-bath-shock step ensures the lamb is cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onions, carrots, and potatoes to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the pomegranate molasses, beef broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the heat and let cool slightly.
Submerge the pot in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Let the stew cool to room temperature, then refrigerate or freeze for later use.
